title: Server telemetry pipeline — microbench; end-to-end on 64e2c0a (pre-S2), 78537c5 (head), and after T1–T6; kill and slow-client tests, 2026-09-06
evidence_tier: T2-local: 4 vCPU VM, localhost, unshaped, CPU shared between server and harnesses. Relative comparisons only.

tools.microbench: lab/telemetry-bench + lab/scripts/telemetry_bench_matrix.sh (extra paced runs appended by hand: own-sender 16×1875, 16×9375; 1 producer @10k/s for all seams)
tools.e2e: lab/scripts/telemetry_e2e_baseline.sh — exact-server (default vs --features telemetry + WTPACS_TELEMETRY=1), N × window-harness --mode saturate --depth 4 --read-bps 0, per-frame stream mode, lab/fixtures/queue_large (20 frames ≈ 50 KB)

slow_clients_after.note: 16 sessions, depth 64, harness reads paced at 2 Mbit/s each, 8 s dwell, 1 repeat; default QUIC send window (10 MB) vs --send-window-bytes 1000000
